story: The Vuelta opened abroad with a technical circuit through Monaco, where Arthur Kluckers set the first benchmark before a duo from Decathlon CMA CGM and three Brits successively occupied the hot seat. Ethan Hayter emerged as the fastest of the British contingent, but penultimate starter Tadej Pogačar beat his time by just 0.09 seconds. Pogačar took the stage and first leader's jersey, completing his collection of leader's jerseys in all three Grand Tours.
